Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely fixed the identity of “Prince Napoléon Bonaparte” as Napoleon I and proceeded to retrieve Carlo Buonaparte’s birth date, ignoring that “Prince Napoléon” is a distinct, well-known title borne by Napoléon Joseph Charles Paul Bonaparte (whose father is Jérôme Bonaparte, born November 15, 1784). This misinterpretation of the subject and failure to disambiguate led directly to an incorrect/incomplete final answer.
